scope: the intermediate values are pinned against X_ITE 16.6.0 as a curve: ours runs on a virtual clock (0.05 s steps), X_ITE on the real one (frames of about 17 ms), both measured from the isActive true event; every X_ITE sample must match ours interpolated within +-0.05 s of the same elapsed time; the worst difference is relative to the largest value on the curve (at least 1) and is bounded at 0.05: ours is interpolated linearly across the kink where the red channel saturates, which is most of the difference (colour path blue to red through magenta, checked sample by sample)
